findings.title: Spread constraint's topology key is on no node
findings.cause: its topologySpreadConstraints spread it over topology.kubernetes.io/zone (whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule), and none of the 1 node has that label, so the scheduler rejects them all; Deployment web has 0 of 2 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match pod topology spread constraints (missing required label). preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.what: none of the 1 node has the label topology.kubernetes.io/zone

findings.fix: Label the nodes with topology.kubernetes.io/zone (cloud providers set the zone labels; kind and bare-metal nodes have none), spread over a label the nodes have, such as kubernetes.io/hostname, or set whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway.
